description:
6 Birches Lane, Blackrock  — A Home With Genuine Wow Factor

Greene Property is delighted to bring to the market this home of genuine distinction, set within one of County Louth’s most sought-after locations.
No. 6 Birches Lane, also known as the Golf Links Road, is a substantial modern residence where elegant proportions, exceptional family living and timeless style come together beautifully.
What makes No. 6 so special is the effortless way in which its traditional home style complements contemporary family life. From the moment you arrive, there is a wonderful sense of space, quality and character that continues throughout this truly impressive home.
Measuring approximately 207 sq. m., this beautifully proportioned five-bedroom residence is exceptionally versatile. The accommodation flows naturally from the refined entrance hallway into elegant reception rooms, fantastic family living spaces and generously proportioned bedroom accommodation.
Throughout, the house is framed by an abundance of character, with well-considered proportions and a layout that works equally well for family life, entertaining and everyday living.
Outside, the property is equally impressive with superb lawned gardens to both the front and rear. Mature planting creates a wonderful sense of privacy and seclusion while the leafy outlook to the front adds significantly to the appeal.
Birch's Lane itself forms a small, semi-gated enclave, beautifully established and dominated by mature trees. It is a wonderfully peaceful setting, yet one that remains remarkably convenient.
Blackrock — Village Living at Its Best
This highly desirable neighbourhood offers a tremendous blend of charm, community and convenience.
Located approximately 3km from Dundalk, Blackrock enjoys an enviable village atmosphere, with local shops, cafés, restaurants and beautiful maritime views all contributing to an exceptional quality of life.
For families, the area is particularly well served, with an excellent choice of junior and secondary schools nearby.
Blackrock offers that increasingly sought-after balance between relaxed village living and easy access to urban amenities. Dublin is within comfortable commuting distance, with regular bus and rail connections available, while Dublin Airport is approximately a 45-minute drive away.
A substantial, character-filled family home in an outstanding setting, No. 6 Birch's Lane is a property that needs to be experienced to be fully appreciated.
Early viewing is highly recommended.
